title: David Saves Keilah

questions.question: What city did David save from the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:1-5 (ESV): “...‘Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah...’ And David... struck down the Philistines... So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.”

questions.question: How did David inquire of the Lord?
options: Using the ephod brought by Abiathar
questions.correctAnswer: Using the ephod brought by Abiathar
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:9 (ESV): “...he said to Abiathar the priest, ‘Bring the ephod here.’”

questions.question: What two things did David ask God about Saul and the men of Keilah?
options: Will Saul come down? Will the men of Keilah surrender me?
Will I be king? Will Saul die?
Will I win? Am I safe?
questions.correctAnswer: Will Saul come down? Will the men of Keilah surrender me?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:11 (ESV): “Will the men of Keilah surrender me into his hand? Will Saul come down...?”

questions.question: Did the men of Keilah plan to surrender David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:12 (ESV): “And the Lord said, ‘They will surrender you.’”

questions.question: Who visited David at Horesh to strengthen his hand in God?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:16 (ESV): “And Jonathan, Saul’s son, rose and went to David at Horesh, and strengthened his hand in God.”

questions.question: Where did David go after leaving Keilah?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:14 (ESV): "And David remained in the strongholds in the wilderness, in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph."

questions.question: What did the Ziphites do?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:19 (ESV): "Then the Ziphites went up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, 'Is not David hiding among us...?’"

questions.question: How many men were with David when he left Keilah?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:13 (ESV): "Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah..."

questions.question: Why did Saul stop pursuing David in the wilderness of Maon?
options: A messenger said the Philistines were invading
questions.correctAnswer: A messenger said the Philistines were invading
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:27-28 (ESV): "But a messenger came to Saul, saying, 'Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid...' So Saul returned from pursuing David..."

questions.question: What was the place called where Saul turned back?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:28 (ESV): "Therefore that place was called the Rock of Escape."

questions.question: Jonathan told David, "You shall be ______ over Israel, and I shall be ______ to you."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:17 (ESV): "'...You shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you.'"

questions.question: Where was Abiathar when he fled to David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:6 (ESV): "When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech had fled to David to Keilah, he had come down with an ephod in his hand."

questions.question: Saul said God had given David into his hand because David had done what?
options: Shut himself in by entering a town with gates and bars
questions.correctAnswer: Shut himself in by entering a town with gates and bars
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:7 (ESV): "...‘God has given him into my hand, for he has shut himself in by entering a town that has gates and bars.’"

questions.question: Where did David dwell at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:29 (ESV): "And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of Engedi."

questions.question: Saul told the Ziphites, "May you be blessed by the Lord, for you have had ______ on me."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 23:21 (ESV): "...‘May you be blessed by the LORD, for you have had compassion on me.’"

key_verse_text: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, rose and went to David at Horesh, and strengthened his hand in God. (ESV)
